HEADER.TITLE: Automatic message retry
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Re-sends outgoing messages that failed, respecting the nature of each provider error. Permanent refusals are never retried.

ENABLED.LABEL: Enable automatic retry
ENABLED.HELP: When off, nothing is re-sent. The routine runs every 5 minutes.

MAX_PER_RUN.LABEL: Maximum per run
MAX_PER_RUN.HELP: Caps how many messages a single run may re-send.

INBOXES.LABEL: Inboxes
INBOXES.HELP: With none selected, the routine acts only on official WhatsApp inboxes.

TRANSIENT.TITLE: Transient errors
TRANSIENT.HELP: The call never reached the provider — a timeout, a 500, a generic error. Retrying within minutes has a real chance.

SLOW.TITLE: Slow errors
SLOW.HELP: The provider accepted and then refused delivery per recipient (131049). The window reopens over hours, so the interval is measured in hours.

CODES.LABEL: Error codes
CODES.HELP: Comma separated. Digits match the code anywhere in the message; text matches as a substring.

DELAYS.LABEL: Intervals (minutes)
DELAYS.HELP: One per attempt, comma separated. The last value repeats.

NEVER.LABEL: Never retry
NEVER.HELP: Permanent refusals. These codes are skipped even if listed above.

PREVIEW_RESULT.TITLE: Simulation
PREVIEW_RESULT.SUMMARY: {examined} messages examined, {retried} would be re-sent now.
